_about: T-210 batch 7 (DRAFT, built in the 2026-10-03 goal loop): the 13 legendaries, in vision.md 8.2b's MYTH register (names approved by the user 2026-10-03). Each entry says what the daemon does now (9.10a), and stops a sentence early. Families: PONTUS, GAIA and OURANOS (sea, earth, and the sky that ends their quarrel by arriving, as TRITON ended the birds'); BOREAS, BRONTES and TYPHON (PHOENIX's three); TALOS, DEUCALION and KHIONE (the sealed three); CASTOR and POLYDEUCES (the twins); KAIROS; ELPIS.

daemons.name: PONTUS
content: It holds everything and has no shape.
Whatever falls into it becomes part
of it, and keeps no edge of its own.
context: It and the land have never agreed
where one ends. Neither ever will.

daemons.name: GAIA
content: Everything else stands on its back.
When it shifts in its sleep, every map
has to be drawn again.
context: It does not argue with the sea. It
simply rises until there is room.

daemons.name: OURANOS
content: It lives above the weather and comes
down only when the sea and the land
will not stop fighting.
context: It takes no side and says nothing.
When it arrives, they both stop.

daemons.name: BOREAS
content: It runs across water without breaking
the surface, and whatever it passes
over is left clear.
context: PHOENIX started it again once. It
has been clearing things ever since.

daemons.name: BRONTES
content: It arrives just after the light, with a
crack that shakes the windows. You
always see it before you hear it.
context: By the time it is heard, whatever it
was announcing has already happened.

daemons.name: TYPHON
content: It sleeps under the mountain and keeps
burning. Every so often the ground
remembers it is there.
context: Covering it over did not put it out.
Nothing ever has.

daemons.name: TALOS
content: It walks the same rounds three times a
day and has never missed one. It does
not know how to stop.
context: Whoever set it walking is long gone.
It still guards the gate for them.

daemons.name: DEUCALION
content: It was a stone thrown over a shoulder.
It stood up, and has never been sure
what it is since.
context: It is made of the same rock as the
mountain. It is not the mountain.

daemons.name: KHIONE
content: Whatever falls into it is kept exactly,
as clear as the day it fell. Nothing
in it has changed in an age.
context: It remembers everything perfectly.
It has never learned a thing.

daemons.name: CASTOR
content: It flies faster than it can be seen,
and whatever it sees, its twin sees
too, however far apart they are.
context: It was always going to end. Its twin
would not let it end alone.

daemons.name: POLYDEUCES
content: It feels what its twin feels and goes
to it without being called. It gave
its twin half of all it had.
context: Now each of them lives half the time.
Neither has ever called it unfair.

daemons.name: KAIROS
content: It is only ever there for a moment.
Reach as it passes and you have it;
reach late and it is gone.
context: Nobody has caught it twice. It does
not come back for the same person.

daemons.name: ELPIS
content: It sleeps at the bottom of a jar for a
thousand years and wakes for seven
days, and in them it listens.
context: Everything else got out of the jar.
It stayed, and it is still there.
